Google CEO Sundar Pichai Shares Career Advice

Google CEO Sundar Pichai has shared a key career lesson for young professionals, advising them to "Never be the brightest person in the room; then you can't learn anything." He suggests putting oneself in uncomfortable situations to foster learning and growth.
